t: You're on Siddons Lane, a street in the City of Westminster. It is named after Sarah Siddons, the Welsh actress. She was the best-known tragedienne of the eighteenth century, and the critic William Hazlitt called her tragedy personified. There isn't much more recorded about the lane itself, but the name keeps her memory in the middle of London, close to the theatres where an actress of her standing would have been at home.
